applicabilityBasis.summary: Avalon markets USDa as a Bitcoin-backed CDP stablecoin and promises 1:1 conversion to USDT through an Ethereum conversion vault within one business day. USDT is a digital asset, which the statutory monetary-value redemption limb expressly distinguishes from national currency or deposits. No direct cash-redemption issuer obligation was established, leaving applicability unclear.

GENIUS Act Public Law 119-27, payment stablecoin definition

genius.notes: Avalon documents 1:1 conversion of USDa to USDT within one business day; this product statement does not establish redemption into national currency or deposits. Interface terms exclude U.S. persons and Hong Kong/Singapore residents or nationals, identify no exact USDa legal issuer and disclaim interface licensing. issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are omitted. No qualifying GENIUS intent or monthly independent reserve attestation was identified in the consulted disclosures. The pre-effective DASP enum describes only GENIUS timing, not permission under other laws.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, independently reopened token disclosures, federal proposal pages, the NYDFS directory and targeted token/operator searches did not identify a public qualifying GENIUS approval, state qualification, token-specific application or foreign registration for Avalon USDa. The exact legal token issuer remains unresolved. This public-source negative finding does not establish absence of unpublished filings or filings under an unidentified legal name.
